title: Calculation Memo — Reserve Base of the True-Up Reserve on a Utility Pass-Through Service Credit Refund
content:
**Calculation.** For the true-up reserve held from a refund of a credit balance on a final-billed Utility Pass-Through Service account, the reserve base is the sum of every water usage charge dated in the last two months where the account has two or more estimated water reads taken in the last two months; it is the latest water usage charge scaled to a full month, that charge times 30 divided by the days of service billed on the trash charge of the latest statement, where the account has exactly one estimated water read taken in the last two months and those days of service are fewer than 10; otherwise it is the latest water usage charge.

## Terms

- **In the last two months**: fewer than 2 whole months separate the date (a charge's statement date, or a read's read date) from the handling date.
- **Latest water usage charge**: the water usage charge with the latest statement date on the account.
- **Days of service**: the days of service billed on the trash charge of the latest statement.
- The reserve base is not rounded; the reserve figured on it is.

## Branches

| Estimated water reads in the last 2 months | Days of service on the latest trash charge | Reserve base |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | any | Sum of every water usage charge dated in the last 2 months |
| exactly 1 | fewer than 10 | Latest water usage charge times 30, divided by those days |
| exactly 1 | 10 or more | Latest water usage charge |
| none | any | Latest water usage charge |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Two estimated reads in the last 2 months; water usage charges of 33.62 and 29.80 dated in that span: reserve base 63.42.
- One estimated read; latest water usage charge 12.40 on a final statement whose trash charge billed 6 days of service: 12.40 times 30, divided by 6, is 62.00.
- One estimated read; latest water usage charge 12.40 with 10 days of service: 12.40.
